entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of the Holy Trinity is a Catholic church in the town of Hlybokaye, Belarus. It belongs to the Hlybokaye Deanery of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Vitebsk. It was made in the Baroque style, it was built between 1764 and 1782, and reconstructed in 1902–1908. The church is located at 1 Sovetskaya Street.
